findings.what: Parallel sessions from default_session_factory share one run_dir and each restarts its screenshot counter at 01, so sibling cases write the SAME evidence file (01-step01-navigate.png). Live run: case_cf844a2b645c and case_rd_loginpage both reference 01-step01-navigate.png; the run dir holds 4 PNGs for 6 captured steps. Deterministic probe (scratchpad/probe_screenshot_collision.py, real BrowserSession, cases run one after the other): Homepage loads and Login page loads both -> ['01-step01-navigate.png'], file holds the last writer's page. A case's judge can be shown a sibling's screenshot -> a silent wrong verdict.

A grader/provider failure in the parallel path turns a COMPLETED execution into outcome=errored with 'not judged: execution errored' and 'no screenshots captured': the case's real RawResult and step evidence are discarded and the failure is misattributed to execution.
